NAME: Ping-Ling Hsu, Ph.D.

●

POSITION TITLE: Assistant Professor

RESEARCH AND/OR PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE:

1984 Research Scientist, Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine, Medical School, University of Texas at the Medical Center, Houston, Texas
1981 - 1984 Senior Staff Fellow, Division of Cancer Biology and Diagnosis, National Cancer Institute, National Institutes of Health, Bethesda, Maryland.

1979 - 1981 Recipient, National Research Service Award (postdoctoral fellowship) in Molecular Biology.

1977 - 1979 Postdoctoral fellow, Division of Biology and Medicine, Brown University, Providence, Rhode Island

1972 - 1977 Graduate student and Teaching assistant, Department of Microbiology and Immunology, University of Illinois at the Medical Center, Chicago
-Ph.D. Thesis: Regulation of Imuunoglobulin saythesis in rabbit lymphocytes.

1971 - 1972 Teaching and research assistant, Department of Chemistry, National Taiwan University.
